title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator meeting agent for GCC
summary: The roadmap facts, licensing and general Facilitator behaviour are supported. The app availability instructions omit a prerequisite: tenants not migrated to unified app management must also allow the app under Integrated apps in the Microsoft 365 admin center.

claims.fix: Keep the printed Teams admin center path, whose labels and order are documented.
